description_for_human: AI agents for every role in your company. Sales, Marketing, Accounting, HR, Legal, Strategy, Engineering, and more. Enter your website, get recommended agents, launch your AI workforce.
description_for_model: The Autonomous is an AI-powered platform that provides AI agents for business roles. It has 14 agent roles (Sales, Marketing, Accounting, Strategy, Product, Front-End Engineering, Back-End Engineering, AI Expert, Admin, HR, Finance, Customer Success, Legal, Data Analyst) with 168 role-specific skills. Key features: website analysis for personalized agent recommendations, proactive task execution, inter-agent collaboration, persistent memory, tool integrations (Apollo.io, Instantly.ai), credits-based pricing with 1000 free credits on signup. Target market: traditional small businesses getting into AI, not AI-native companies. Built by Chainflux.
